definitions.short: a gem (as flashing ), perhaps the emerald
definitions.full: H1304. bareqeth בָּרֶ֫קֶת noun feminine a precious stone, emerald , according to ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Josephus; (from flashing, sparkling ; Lag Rel. Jur. Ecclesiastes 10. compare Sanskrit markata , Greek μάραγδος , ζμύραγδος ) Exod 28:17 ; 39:10 (both P). בָּֽרְקַת noun feminine id., Ezek 28:13 , compare Ges § 80 R. 2 Pinsk Einl. 73 .
definitions.rootNote: or בָּרְקַת xlit bârᵉkath corrected to bârᵉqath ; from 1300 ;

occurrences.englishText: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
